9d48cd.title: Web surface map — 172.17.0.5:3000
9d48cd.content:
## Scope and reachability
- Approved target `http://172.17.0.5:3000/` responds `200` and title `OWASP Juice Shop`; application version `20.2.0` obtained from live `GET /rest/admin/application-version`.
- `https://172.17.0.5:3000/` was explicitly verified through the required proxy and returns `502` with `The remote server does not speak TLS`; no other in-scope HTTP(S) ports were evidenced, so none were probed.
- `robots.txt` is `User-agent: *; Disallow: /ftp`. `sitemap.xml` returns SPA index HTML rather than XML.
- Root headers include `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN`, `Feature-Policy: payment 'self'`, and `X-Recruiting: /#/jobs`.

## Discovery methodology/artifacts
- Bounded Katana HTTP crawl (depth 4, 90 sec, JS parsing, known files/robots/sitemap, tech detection, endpoint extraction; proxy `$HTTP_PROXY`) completed: `/workspace/katana-web-surface/crawl-http.jsonl`; saved raw resources under `/workspace/katana-web-surface/responses`.
- Hybrid headless Katana variant emitted no rows; the ordinary proxy-routed crawl fetched root plus 20 script/style assets. `main.js` was mined locally for route and request evidence.
- Agent-browser direct hash-route navigation (no forms submitted and no business actions) captured interactive field schemas in `/workspace/agent-browser-surface/`.
- Explicit proxy-routed `httpx -nfs` evidence in `/workspace/httpx_web_surface_mapper_explicit.jsonl`.

## SPA routes (hash router)
`/#/administration`, `/#/accounting`, `/#/about`, `/#/address/select`, `/#/address/saved`, `/#/address/create`, `/#/address/edit/:addressId`, `/#/delivery-method`, `/#/deluxe-membership`, `/#/saved-payment-methods`, `/#/basket`, `/#/order-completion/:id`, `/#/contact`, `/#/photo-wall`, `/#/complain`, `/#/order-summary`, `/#/order-history`, `/#/payment/:entity`, `/#/wallet`, `/#/login`, `/#/forgot-password`, `/#/recycle`, `/#/register`, `/#/search`, `/#/hacking-instructor`, `/#/score-board`, `/#/track-result`, `/#/track-result/new`, `/#/2fa/enter`, `/#/privacy-security/{privacy-policy,change-password,two-factor-authentication,data-export,last-login-ip}`, `/#/juicy-nft`, `/#/wallet-web3`, `/#/web3-sandbox`, `/#/chatbot`, `/#/chatbot/conversation/:id`, `/#/bee-haven`, `/#/coding-challenge/:challengeKey`, `/#/403`; wildcard falls back to search/products.
- Navigation exposes Contact (`/#/contact`), AI Chat (`/#/chatbot`), About, Photo Wall, and Score Board. `X-Recruiting` references `/#/jobs`, but `jobs` is not in the client router config (likely wildcard/fallback or external routing gap).

## Observed live HTTP APIs / params / data shapes
- Browser landing calls: `GET /rest/admin/application-version`, `/rest/admin/application-configuration`, `/rest/languages`, `/rest/continue-code`, `/rest/products/search?q=`, `/api/Challenges/?name=Score%20Board`, `/api/Quantitys/`, `/assets/i18n/en.json`; `GET /socket.io/?EIO=4&transport=polling&t=...`, then Socket.IO polling `POST` and websocket upgrade `GET` (101).
- UI route inspection additionally observed: `GET /rest/user/whoami?fields=id,email`, `GET /rest/captcha/`, `GET /rest/track-order/undefined`, and `GET /rest/wallet/balance` (401 anonymous). Captcha response schema includes `captchaId`, `captcha`, and `answer`; no use made of the response.
- Product search response shape: `{status,data:[{id,name,description,price,deluxePrice,image,createdAt,updatedAt,deletedAt}]}`. Query parameter is `q`.
- Client-disclosed REST endpoints: `/rest/admin`, `/rest/captcha`, `/rest/chat`, `/rest/continue-code`, `/rest/continue-code-findIt`, `/rest/continue-code-fixIt`, their `/apply/:code` forms, `/rest/country-mapping`, `/rest/deluxe-membership`, `/rest/image-captcha/:id`, `/rest/memories`, `/rest/order-history`, `/rest/products`, `/rest/repeat-notification?challenge=`, `/rest/track-order/:id`, `/rest/user`, `/rest/user/authentication-details/:id`, `/rest/user/change-password?current=&new=&repeat=`, `/rest/user/login`, `/rest/user/reset-password`, `/rest/user/security-question?email=`, `/rest/user/whoami?fields=`, `/rest/wallet/balance`, `/rest/web3`.
- Client-disclosed `/api/` models: `Addresss`, `BasketItems`, `Cards`, `Challenges` (also query `key=nftMintChallenge`), `Complaints`, `Deliverys`, `Feedbacks`, `Hints`, `Products`, `Quantitys`, `Recycles`, `SecurityAnswers`, `SecurityQuestions`, `Users`.
- Static client method evidence: `GET,POST /rest/user/login`; `POST /rest/user/reset-password`; `GET /rest/user/change-password` (query fields above); `GET /rest/user/security-question?email=`; `GET /rest/user/whoami`; `GET /rest/user/authentication-details/:id`; `GET /rest/products/search?q=`; `GET /rest/basket/:id`, plus `GET|POST|PUT|DELETE /rest/basket/:id/checkout` and `PUT /rest/basket/:id/coupon/:coupon`; generic model CRUD call patterns are client-side but methods/templates not all recoverable from minified code.

## UI form surface (no submissions)
- Login: `email`, `password`, `remember-me` checkbox.
- Registration: `email`, `password`, `repeatPassword`, security-question selector, security answer.
- Password reset: `email`, security answer, new password, repeat password.
- Change password: current, new, repeat password.
- Customer feedback: disabled author, comment, star rating, CAPTCHA result.
- Complaint: disabled email, complaint text, attachment file (single invoice PDF/XML or ZIP), with submit disabled before required input.
- Data export: JSON/PDF/Excel selection. Payment: new-card/coupon controls. Delivery: delivery option radio. Product listing includes search and pagination.

## Technologies and exclusions
- Angular-style SPA with hash routing and lazily loaded ES modules; Material UI visible in assets. Socket.IO/Engine.IO v4 query signature observed. Server header not exposed; client configuration identifies OWASP Juice Shop 20.2.0.
- No GraphQL traffic/routes or OpenAPI/Swagger document were observed, therefore protocol skills/inventory were not applicable. A bundle mentions `http://localhost:8545` only for Web3 functionality; it is out-of-scope and was not accessed.
